args.reason: The PRDR adds one --dry-run flag that runs the existing merge-floor reads and skips only the final GitHub merge call. Every DoD item serves the first PRD goal, inspecting merge eligibility without risking a merge, and nothing in the DoD goes beyond the declared goals. Reusing the floor logic unchanged keeps it the single source of truth, which meets the second goal. The test-double assertion that no merge call happens checks the safety property directly. No gold-plating and no unserved cited goal.
